result.stdout:
NacreCraft mod development tools

Usage: ncm <tool> [options]

Tools:
  icon         Generate a white background mod icon with the mod name
  init         Create a new NacreCraft mod project
  template     Browse and pull mod templates
  add          Add a dependency, a reference or an injection rule to the project
  restore      Resolve the declared packages and copy their assemblies into the project
  build        Diagnose and build the mod project in the current directory
  clean        Remove the project build cache, or the shared download cache when there is no project here
  asm          Inspect a .NET assembly: type list, type details, decompiled source, dependencies, resources
  hook         Check the injection rules of a mod in ncmod.json and in Annotations against the types they name
  callgraph    Inspect the project call graph and report call cycles
  runserver    Build the current mod and run the NacreCraft server
  runclient    Build the current mod and run the NacreCraft client
  upgrade      Convert a csproj based mod project to a .ncproj one
  update       Check nuget.org and update ncm to the latest version
  tool         Install, remove and run ncm plugins

Run 'ncm help <tool>' to see the parameters of one tool.
